title: concept-brain: a brain that is never switched off (binary neurons, one local learning rule, innate wiring, speech only through muscles)
description: Research prototype of an artificial brain that lives one continuous life: binary neurons wired at birth by one generator, one local Hebbian rule with concave growth and one global decay, output only through muscles. Includes the rules-only architecture, the theory (the prefrontal Hebbian readout equals an autoregressive language model's readout under stated conditions), measurements of the built brain, and a test on an invented logic language in which the brain learns by listening and answers in turn. Technical report in docs/paper (English PDF and Chinese version).
